title: Scope of a max cut constraint
statement: For a constraint in the max cut template on a variable set $V$, its scope is the embedding of the two positions of the constraint into $V$; that is, it sends each position to the variable assigned to that position by the constraint.
hypotheses_covered: A max cut constraint on a variable set $V$
